title: Grade 6 Math — Tue, May 26
description: Algebraic Expressions — Day 2 of 5: Like terms and coefficients
subject: mathematics

questions.question: Which of these are LIKE terms?
questions.explanation: Like terms have the same variable raised to the same power. 5x and 7x both have variable x.

questions.question: Which pair are UNLIKE terms?
questions.explanation: Unlike terms have different variables. 4p has variable p and 4q has variable q — they're unlike.

questions.question: In 9y, what is the coefficient of y?
questions.explanation: In 9y, the number 9 is multiplied by variable y. So 9 is the coefficient of y.

questions.question: Identify the like terms in: 3a, 2b, 5a, 4c, 7b
questions.explanation: 3a and 5a are like (both have 'a'). 2b and 7b are like (both have 'b').

questions.question: What is the coefficient of x in the expression −4x?
questions.explanation: In −4x, the coefficient of x is −4 (including the negative sign).

questions.question: Which expression has only one term?
questions.explanation: 4mn is a single term (a product of number and variables). Expressions with one term are called monomials.

questions.question: In 7p + 3q − 2p, which terms are like?
questions.explanation: 7p and −2p both contain the variable p — they are like terms.

questions.question: What is the coefficient of x² in 5x²?
questions.explanation: In 5x², the number 5 is the coefficient. (Note: x² is unlike x, so 5x and 5x² are unlike terms.)

questions.question: An expression with exactly two unlike terms is called a:
questions.explanation: Binomial = two terms (e.g., 3x + 4). Monomial = one term. Trinomial = three terms.

questions.question: Which is the coefficient of y in the expression y?
questions.explanation: y means 1 × y. When no number is written before a variable, its coefficient is 1.

questions.question: From: 3x, 5y, 2x, 4z, 6y — pick all like terms.
questions.explanation: Like terms share the same variable: 3x & 2x (both 'x'), 5y & 6y (both 'y').

questions.question: In the expression 11z + 0, the coefficient of z is:
questions.explanation: In 11z + 0, the coefficient of z is 11. Adding 0 doesn't change anything.

questions.question: Which expression is a trinomial?
questions.explanation: Trinomial = exactly 3 terms. x + y + z has three terms: x, y, z.

questions.question: 4ab and 6ba are:
questions.explanation: 4ab = 4×a×b and 6ba = 6×b×a = 6×a×b. Multiplication is commutative, so ab = ba. They are like terms.
